U.note: Clean, well-structured entry with a nice ember-seam mark, but the ash-and-volcano dragon and its lookalike list are stock.

V.note: A wingless, Komodo-scaled fell dragon with taxonomic history and a bluffing fire display; grounded, witty and usable.

W.note: Draco-lizard wing ribs and a sheep-fold type record are inventive, though the chatty preamble line and length cost it a little.

X.note: Opens with the burn-line trace and vanishing winter records, which makes it feel like real fieldcraft.

Y.note: Competent but generic high-fantasy dragon with hoards, thermals and horns, and little new.

Z.note: The fjord-wyrm sign-first structure, seasonal table and sealers' similes are vivid and consistent, though it runs long.
